title: Code and data for: Are LLM Agent Leaderboards Reliable? A Survey and Multi-Run Analysis of Agent Reliability Evaluation
description: Code and derived data accompanying the paper "Are LLM Agent Leaderboards Reliable? A Survey and Multi-Run Analysis of Agent Reliability Evaluation". Contains the leaderboard census (item-sampling and fixed-task rerun bounds over 22 public agent leaderboards; derived per-entry statistics only), the Terminal-Bench 2.0 multi-run analysis, and a small pinned harness illustration. Please cite the paper, not this record.
notes: Code: MIT. Derived data: CC BY 4.0. Raw leaderboard files are not redistributed.
